name: satisfiability
source: SATLIB - The Satisfiability Library (H. H. Hoos and T. Stuetzle), benchmark page https://www.cs.ubc.ca/~hoos/SATLIB/benchm.html : Uniform Random-3-SAT, phase transition region, unforced filtered; the nine satisfiable sets uf50-218 to uf250-1065, each one tar archive of DIMACS .cnf files. Of each set the instances numbered 1 to 12 are used (members uf<n>-01.cnf to uf<n>-012.cnf); the archives are read in memory and never unpacked
terms: the benchmark page and the description page of the sets (Benchmarks/SAT/RND3SAT/descr.html) carry no licence and no terms of use; the page only asks for contributions of benchmark problems. Fetched by hash, not redistributed here.
reference: every instance is satisfiable: the source separated satisfiable from unsatisfiable formulae with a complete algorithm and lists these sets as 'all satisfiable'. A proved status, not a bound; no satisfying assignment is published (kernel only: an answer scores 1 when it satisfies every clause, 0 otherwise)
